title: cynanchica staliana subsp. diomedea
intro: Cynanchica staliana subsp. diomedea, commonly known as the Diomedes's swallowwort or Cynanchum diomedea, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchica staliana subsp. diomedea include treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
